profile.headline: Software Developer at VGM Homelink
profile.summary: Full-stack Web Developer known as a very persistent, creative, and an exceptional problem solver. I have experience developing web apps from the ground up, am highly self-motivated, and work well on teams. I am constantly learning new technology and am passionate about development. With each project I work on, I ensure the products I build are highly polished and well developed using SOLID principles.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: DevOps · Front-End Development · Full-Stack Development · Leadership · C#

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description:
Maintained and updated code to reflect new state tax changes for retail store product. Wrote and updated unit tests using C# to ensure product features and logic is correctly working.

Worked closely with tax experts in the field to fix any defects within the software.

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained a cross-platform, ionic-react app that allowed customers to maintain warehouse slots, track/log their truck loading process, and upload documents for orders.

Developed a cross-platform ionic-angular app that customers used to track their assets by uploading their information to our cloud database. Oversaw customer support for rollout.

Developed .Net Xamarin app that provided a third-party hardware interaction to a mobile device in real-time that produced a more efficient system for clients when trying to upload shipment information to our database. 

Produced a web service for database manipulation utilizing node.js and SQL. Provided service to inhouse developers for future development.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Software Project Management · DevOps · Software Design · Back-End Web Development

positions.title: Semester Intern
positions.description:
Created a web app that would allow Cerner employees to enter information on a web-page to generate a configuration file for a system within Cerner. Once the data was entered via the app, it would then generate a xml file with config details that could be dropped into the target system. This translated into a time savings of 1-2 hours of manual config creation and human-error reduction each time the config had to be changed.

Used React.js and Python for development. Hosted using Docker and Flask.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Software Development

positions.title: Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a Full-Stack web app for high school business class. Allowed students to go online and place an order for the student ran coffee shop.

Used C# and asp.net for and Microsoft Sql Server for development. Hosted using GoDaddy
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Web Development · C# · JavaScript · Full-Stack Development
